name: Button
summary: Primary action control with 7 semantic variants, async double-click protection (aria-busy), high-contrast outlined danger variant, and 2px keyboard focus ring.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual role mapped strictly to Millar surface and contrast tokens.

props.name: pill
props.description: Applies --radius-pill (9999px) for starter or filter pill buttons.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Square icon button; REQUIRES explicit aria-label.

props.name: loading
props.description: External loading state (also auto-enabled while async onClick Promise settles).

invalidPropGuardrails: Do NOT pass variant='destructive', variant='outline', or variant='link' (use 'danger', 'white', or 'ghost').
Do NOT render iconOnly={true} without a descriptive aria-label.
Do NOT apply CSS gradients or drop shadows to Button.
Do NOT render solid crimson background with white text in dark mode (fails contrast at 2.51:1); 'danger' uses outlined --status-error.

whenToUse: Use 'primary' at most once per PageHeader or Dialog footer for the single main action.
Use 'white' or 'secondary' for supporting actions and toolbar buttons.
Use 'danger' paired with ConfirmDialog for irreversible destructive actions.
whenNotToUse: Do not use Button for pure route navigation when a semantic <a> link belongs.
Do not place more than 1 primary Button in the same visual header.

responsiveBehavior: Maintains >= 40px default height (44px lg) and >= 32px icon-only dimensions; wraps cleanly inside PageHeader action groups below 640px.

rolesAndAttributes: aria-busy during async submit without dropping focus

keyboard.behavior: Activates button unless disabled or busy.

exampleCode:
import { Button, IconAdd } from "@hahlex/millar-ui";

<Button variant="primary" icon={<IconAdd size="md" />} onClick={handleCreate}>
  Create workspace
</Button>

name: Input & Form Controls
summary: Accessible Input, TextArea, Select, Switch, Checkbox, ChoiceToggle, and HelpTooltip controls with 2px visible focus rings, decoupled help hints, and role='alert' validation errors.

props.name: hint
props.description: Optional 1-2 sentence explanation rendered in a click/hover/focus HelpTooltip outside <label>.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message linked via aria-describedby and announced via role='alert'.

invalidPropGuardrails: Never rely on placeholder text as a substitute for label.
Never suppress focus outline with outline: none without replacing with .millar-focus.
In ChoiceToggle / checked pills on --accent-soft, ALWAYS use --fg-on-accent-soft (#362218), NEVER --fg-accent.

whenToUse: All operational forms, filters, settings, and inline editors.
whenNotToUse: Never render raw <input> directly inside feature views when Input or Select applies.

responsiveBehavior: Full-width fluid inputs at 40px height; HelpTooltip supports click/tap on touch devices with >= 24x24px target.

rolesAndAttributes: aria-describedby pointing to role='alert' error paragraph

keyboard.behavior: Moves focus sequentially with visible 2px .millar-focus ring.
Toggles Switch, Checkbox, ChoiceToggle, or HelpTooltip.

exampleCode:
import { Input } from "@hahlex/millar-ui";

<Input
  label="Workspace slug"
  hint="Used in permanent API URLs."
  placeholder="hahlex-studio"
  error={slugError}
/>

name: ChoiceToggle
summary: High-contrast option switch (e.g., Light/Dark or EN/VI) pairing --accent-soft with --fg-on-accent-soft (7.69:1 AAA across both themes).
invalidPropGuardrails: Never style active state with --fg-accent on --accent-soft (1.00:1 invisible in dark mode).

whenToUse: Compact binary or ternary preferences (Theme, Locale, Register, Viewport).
whenNotToUse: Do not use for more than 4 options; use Select or Tabs instead.

responsiveBehavior: Compact inline control with 30px internal buttons inside a 38px bordered tray.

name: Card
summary: Single-elevation structural surface (base, inset, or raised) with 1px warm-sand border and canonical 16px/18px interior padding.

props.name: surface
props.description: Selects Surface Role fill and border/shadow pairing.

invalidPropGuardrails: Never nest Cards inside Cards.
Never wrap a primary page DataTable inside an extra outer Card.
Never attach a one-sided thick accent border down the side of a rounded Card.

whenToUse: Grouping related metrics, settings panels, or record detail facets.
whenNotToUse: Do not use equal-sized Card grids as the default marketing layout.

responsiveBehavior: Fluid block container with consistent padding across breakpoints.

rolesAndAttributes: Plain container; nest semantic headings and buttons inside rather than making the entire div a fake button.

keyboard.behavior: Focuses interactive elements inside the card directly.

exampleCode:
import { Card } from "@hahlex/millar-ui";

Workspace health

All token contrast gates passed.

name: Badge
summary: Pill-shaped status and governance tag combining border, soft wash, and leading indicator dot/icon so color is never the sole signal.

props.name: dot
props.description: Renders a 6px status indicator dot alongside the text label.

invalidPropGuardrails: Never render bare unstyled colored text for statuses; always wrap in Badge.

whenToUse: Lifecycle labels (Draft, Approved, Deprecated), operational statuses, and compact counts.
whenNotToUse: Do not use Badge as a clickable button; use Button pill instead.

responsiveBehavior: Inline-flex with nowrap text; wraps cleanly inside flex badge rows.

rolesAndAttributes: Pairs text + dot/icon so color-blind users never rely on hue alone.

name: Stat
summary: Operational KPI tile using full-box color mixing, tinted IconBox, --text-kpi (24px tabular-nums), and optional solid progress bar.
invalidPropGuardrails: Never color only a bare digit without container framing.
Never use CSS gradients on the progress bar.

whenToUse: Operational dashboard KPI rows and report summaries.
whenNotToUse: Do not use as a generic marketing hero-metric box.

responsiveBehavior: Stacks cleanly in 1/2/4-column CSS grids across mobile, tablet, and desktop.

rolesAndAttributes: Progress bar exposes role='progressbar', aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-label.

exampleCode:
import { Stat, IconShield } from "@hahlex/millar-ui";

<Stat label="Contrast checks" value="80 / 80" delta="WCAG 2.1 AA" tone="success" icon={<IconShield size="md" />} progressPercent={100} />

name: Tabs & Segmented
summary: APG-compliant Tabs with full Arrow/Home/End keyboard navigation and Segmented option rail.

props.name: items
props.description: Tab definitions with id, label, and panel content.

invalidPropGuardrails: Do not omit ariaLabel on Tabs.
Do not trap Tab key inside tablist (Arrow keys move between tabs; Tab moves to panel).

whenToUse: Component doc views (Playground | Guidelines | Code | Accessibility) and Record Detail facets.
whenNotToUse: Do not use Tabs for top-level site navigation.

responsiveBehavior: Flex-wraps cleanly on compact viewports without horizontal overflow scrollbars.

keyboard.behavior: Moves focus and activates adjacent tab.
Jumps to first or last tab.
Moves focus from active tab into tabpanel content.

exampleCode:
import { Tabs } from "@hahlex/millar-ui";

<Tabs ariaLabel="Component details" activeId={tab} onChange={setTab} items={items} />

name: DataTable & FilterBar
summary: Zero-scrollbar semantic DataTable with '-' empty cells, tabular numeric alignment, and mobileCard mode, paired with immediate-apply FilterBar.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column schema with optional numeric alignment and custom cell renderer.

props.name: rows
props.description: Dataset rows for the current page.

props.name: mobileCard
props.description: Card layout rendered for compact phone viewports (< 640px).

invalidPropGuardrails: Never add horizontal or vertical inner scrollbars to primary page DataTables; fit columns and paginate.
Never render U+2014 em-dash in empty table cells; render '-'.

whenToUse: Directories, token explorers, audit logs, and structured operational records.
whenNotToUse: Do not use DataTable for purely visual marketing grids.

responsiveBehavior: Fixed-layout zero-scrollbar table on desktop/tablet; switches to mobileCard list below 640px.

rolesAndAttributes: Semantic <table>, <caption>, <th scope='col'>, tabular-nums on numeric columns

keyboard.behavior: Moves through FilterBar controls, active filter pill dismiss buttons, and row actions.

exampleCode:
import { DataTable } from "@hahlex/millar-ui";

<DataTable caption="Token inventory" columns={columns} rows={rows} rowKey={(r) => r.id} />

name: Dialog, ConfirmDialog & Feedback
summary: Accessible modal Dialog (Escape close, focus restoration, dirty-form backdrop lock), destructive ConfirmDialog, Alert, solid Skeleton, EmptyState, and LoadFailed.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible dialog title bound via aria-labelledby.

props.name: dirty
props.description: Prevents accidental backdrop click dismissal when form has unsaved edits.

invalidPropGuardrails: Never open a destructive action without ConfirmDialog tone='danger'.
Never use gradient shimmer on Skeleton; use solid --bg-surface-2 fills.

whenToUse: Tasks requiring protected focus or explicit confirmation before irreversible change.
whenNotToUse: Do not open a modal for non-interruptive info that fits inline or in a Drawer.

responsiveBehavior: Max 85dvh centered modal on desktop; compact padded modal on phone screens.

rolesAndAttributes: role='alert' on error Alerts and LoadFailed
Restores focus to trigger element on close

name: AppShell & PageHeader
summary: Product-agnostic application workspace frame with skip-to-main link, semantic sidebar navigation, and decluttered PageHeader.

props.name: brand
props.description: Canonical Hahlex lockup or tenant workspace switcher.

props.name: navItems
props.description: Navigation entries with active aria-current='page' state.

invalidPropGuardrails: Never hardcode education-specific routes or labels inside AppShell.
Never omit the skip-to-main-content anchor.

whenToUse: Root chrome of every Hahlex operational web application.
whenNotToUse: Do not use AppShell for public marketing landing pages.

responsiveBehavior: Fixed 240px left rail with fluid main workspace; mobile menu trigger toggles compact navigation.

keyboard.behavior: First focusable element is Skip to main content.
